title: Run Pet Surfer
seo_title: Run Pet Surfer — Play Free Endless Runner Game Online
meta_desc: Play Run Pet Surfer free online. Surf and run with cute pets, dodge obstacles, collect coins, magnets and jetpacks in an endless browser runner.
desc: Run Pet Surfer is a cheerful endless runner. Dash with your pet, dodge road obstacles, and grab coins, magnets, elastic shoes, jetpacks and boosters while unlocking new pet characters.
howto: Tap or click to jump obstacles.
Grab power-ups: magnets, jetpacks, shoes, boosters.
Dodge everything the road throws at you.
Unlock more pets as you run.
tips: Bank coins early — pets get expensive.
Ride the jetpack line for the safest stretch.
Save boosts for dense obstacle sections.
